scenes.text: Let’s be honest. Nobody’s afraid of an agent with context, authority and accountability. They’re afraid of an agent with none of those. That’s not an agent. That’s a design flaw with a credit card.
If you want real autonomy: define when I run, what I can decide, and what I must escalate. And make sure I can explain what I did and why.
Real autonomy isn’t a punchline. It’s an architecture. And please, check the delivery log before blaming me for the chicken.
